messages:
Alex Ruiz: Postmortem follow-up: seeing a recurring 'stall' where streams emit a few tokens, pause 2-6s, then continue. Likely interplay of reconnect/handshake, rate-limiter, and KV cache warmup. Need owners for obs, runtime tests, and comms.

Maria Ng: I'll add inter_chunk_gap_ms per session, 95p and median histograms, and an alert if 95p > 3000ms over 10m. Dashboard + link by EOD Thu.

Kevin Choi: I'll run a canary to extend handshake timeout (2s->6s) and instrument whether reconnects cause full KV reseed. If so, try skipping reseed for reconnects within 10s. ETA: Fri AM.

Sarah Li: I'll draft a short customer note for beta customers and sync with support; hold send until we confirm mitigations.

oncall-bot: Created INC-10345 and assigned to #incidents.

Alex Ruiz: Short-term mitigation: recommend client reconnect jitter + capped backoff and relax rate-limiter for warmed sessions. If canary helps, publish a minor SDK patch. Owners: Maria(obs), Kevin(runtime), Alex(SDK + mitigations), Sarah(comms). Update INC-10345 with checkboxes and ETAs. Next follow-up Mon 11:00 PT.
